content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, you're likely familiar with the frustration of being locked out of platforms like Stripe and PayPal, making it difficult to receive payments for your digital products. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-6|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-4|The Full]] problem is not unique to these countries, as many creators worldwide face similar challenges. In this guide, we'll explore how to set up a NOWPayments digital store, allowing you to receive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-9|crypto]] payments without relying on restrictive platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The NOWPayments infrastructure is designed to work around platform restrictions, providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows creators to own their data and receive payments directly. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees. This infrastructure is particularly useful for creators in countries with restrictive financial systems, where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to set up a few essential components, including a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting account, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, and a Supabase or Google Sheets order storage system. You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account and set up your cryptocurrency wallet. With these components in place, you'll be ready to start receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to work with your chosen cryptocurrency wallet and backend logic. You'll also need to set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to automatically deliver your digital products to customers after payment confirmation. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the templates and blueprints you need to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack.
NOWPayments provides a sovereign digital commerce stack with no platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on Tron. The platform's automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, ensuring fast and reliable delivery of your digital products. You can monitor your transactions and track your sales in real-time, giving you complete control over your digital commerce stack.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to a scaling playbook that provides guidance on how to optimize your backend logic, increase storage capacity, and improve delivery speeds. You'll also learn how to leverage the low transaction fees on Solana, which average fractions of a cent per transaction, to minimize your costs and maximize your profits.

With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the templates and blueprints you need to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything you need to get started with receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting account, configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets order storage system, create a NOWPayments account, and configure your cryptocurrency wallet. Next, set up your file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Finally, go live and start processing transactions, monitoring your sales and scaling your infrastructure as needed.
